title: Property Seizure Inventory and Property/Evidence Booking Log

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the California Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

The property seizure inventory, property and evidence receipt, search warrant return and receipt, and property/evidence booking log related to items seized at 2961 Georgia St. Apt. 2 Oakland, CA and 3247 Delaware St. Oakland, CA between 1997 and 2008. These seizures were made in connection with the arrests of Antonio R. Burrell. The Burrell family is seeking, among other items from the property seizures, a blue photo album with gold trim containing irreplaceable photographs documenting their history and kinship ties.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 calendar days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Reagan Ross

To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Government Records Access and Management Act, I hereby request the following records:

To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Government Access and Management Act (GRAMA) I hereby request the following records:

Related to all AXON products including body cameras, "Prepared AI", "Carbyne", "Axon AI", "Axon Vision", and "Lead Lock" by or in partnership with Salt Lake County Sheriff, Salt Lake County, Salt Lake Police Department, Salt Lake Unified Police, West Valley City Police, and other municipal police departments:

All contracts, agreements, memoranda of understanding, or other instruments between Salt Lake County Sheriff Department and other municipal police departments and AXON, or any related entity, including any amendments or renewals. (No date restriction.)

All invoices, payment records, and purchase orders related to AXON products, software, or services. (January 1, 2024 through present.)

All data retention policies governing footage, or associated metadata collected by AXON products and cameras. (No date restriction.)

All written policies, procedures, or general orders governing officer access to, and use of, AXON data. (No date restriction.)

All records reflecting the total number of AXON body cameras deployed, their locations, and dates of deployment. (January 1, 2024 through present.)

All records of third-party data sharing, including but not limited to agreements or logs of data shared with other law enforcement agencies, federal agencies, or private parties. (January 1, 2024 through present.)

All audit logs, access logs, or query logs reflecting searches of AXON data by police officers and employees or contractors. (January 1, 2024 through present.)

All records reflecting complaints, grievances, or legal challenges related to AXON products. (January 1, 2024 through present.)

All communications, including email and internal messaging platform records, between  Salt Lake County Sheriff Department officers and employees and AXON. representatives regarding the procurement, deployment, expansion, or renewal of the program. (January 1, 2024 through present.)

Any privacy impact assessments, legal reviews, or internal memoranda regarding the program's compliance with Utah law. (No date restriction.)

If any portion of a responsive record is withheld, please identify each withheld document by description, date, author, and recipient in a detailed withholding log, and specify the statutory exception claimed for each.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Emma E Metos
